text: EDH 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的插件集合，以会话页眉中的总开关管理多个可独立启停的功能。它把各项能力拆成 Harness bundle 模块，并在浏览器界面和 Host 服务间配合工作。主要功能包括失败请求重试、会话 Markdown 导出、MCP 服务器工具接入、历史会话全文搜索和手机端局域网远程访问。适合希望在一个 Harness 插件中扩展会话管理、工具和移动访问的用户。远程访问需自行设置用户名和密码，MCP 功能需配置服务器。

EDH adds switchable features to the DeepSeek Harness web client. It offers failed-request retries, Markdown session export, MCP server tools, full-text session search, and phone access over a configured LAN connection.

EDH 的功能「失败请求重试」：在模型请求失败后等待退避时间，并在同一轮继续重试；请求取消或功能关闭时停止等待。
EDH 的功能「会话 Markdown 导出」：通过会话页眉的导出操作下载当前会话，正文按消息顺序整理，并附会话标题、时间和消息数。
EDH 的功能「MCP 服务器工具」：在设置页添加或启动 MCP 服务器，发现其工具并注册到 Harness，供模型调用；也可测试、停止或移除服务器。
EDH 的功能「历史会话搜索」：后台增量建立本地索引，并在 Ctrl+K 搜索面板中按关键词查找会话消息、筛选结果。
EDH 的功能「手机远程访问」：在设置中启用并配置登录信息后，通过局域网监听器代理同一 Harness 网页界面，供手机浏览器访问。

@moreweb/edh README · Features：| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| `retry` | Retries a failed model request inside the same turn, with no attempt limit |
| `edit` | Adds a pencil to every user message: forks the Session just before it and puts the text back in the composer |
| `btw` | `/btw` and `/side` open a side chat: a fork of this conversation, shown beside it in the right-hand pane |
| `export` | Downloads the Session as a Markdown document |
| `update` | Updates EDH itself from its published repo, from EDH's page in Plugin Manager, and reloads the new browser half in place |
| `mcp` | Connects MCP servers from a settings page — no Cordis config — and gives their tools to the model as it goes |
| `remote` | Opens the same Web GUI on a phone over the LAN, behind a login page and a username and password you set |
| `usage` | Shows where your tokens went: totals, per model and per day across every Session, with streaks and peaks |
| `mobile` | Serves the web app manifest, so a phone can add the GUI to its home screen and open it without browser chrome |
| `notify` | Serves a curated few of the real Windows sound files, so a notification plays the sound you already know |
